description.narrative: Bidraget tar upp strukturella utmaningar på arbetsmarknaden i Bosnien och Hercegovina som oproportionerligt påverkar arbetsresultaten för kvinnor, ungdomar och utsatta individer. Åtgärden arbetar med att förbättra utformningen, genomförandet och genomförandet av aktiva arbetsmarknadspolitiker med tonvikt på inriktning och antagande/diversifiering av portföljerna, vilket möjliggör utformning och genomförande av program för långtidsarbetslösa och svåranställda kategorier i samarbete med relevanta intressenter .

The contribution addresses structural labor market challenges in Bosnia and Herzegovina that disproportionally affect labor outcomes of women, youth and vulnerable individuals. The action works on improving the design, implementation and performance of active labor market policies with emphasis on targeting and adoption/diversification of the portfolios, enabling the design and implementation of programs for long-term unemployed and hard to employ categories in cooperation with relevant stakeholders.

In this reporting period, the grant selection procedure was completed, and 16 interventions (projects) were launched on 1 July 2024. As a remainder grant scheme was organized in a manner that eligible partners (NGOs, associations) in cooperation with public employment services and local communities implement activation and employment schemes. In the process selected interventions reached nearly 5000 (4,874) individuals, out of which 1,673 entered second stage (so called pathways).
For clarity purposes pathway is a whole set of services and programs that a job seeker received depending on specific and individual needs i.e. it includes elements of outreach and activation, skills development and employment or self-employment. The project exceeded initially set targets by 20% and 31.7%, as per Pathway 1 and 2.
1,276 beneficiaries began receiving tailored support through participation in suitable programs (e.g., onthejob training, institutional training, employment subsidies, selfemployment support) in line with individual support plans developed based on the beneficiaries barriers, needs, and aspirations. It was unexpected but by the end of the reporting period selected implementing partners reported that 59 beneficiaries had transitioned to employment by the end of 2024. It is assessed that implementation of first seven months is measuring satisfactory results and in some areas beyond expectations.
According to ILO future implementation will require close monitoring and guidance in the upcoming period as the progress aims towards reaching outcomelevel results. The anticipated deterioration of economic outlooks implies notable risks and challenges in that regard.
Pathways are implemented under the guidance of the ILO project team, consisting of intensive technical and operational capacitybuilding delivered to partners during this reporting period. The ILO project team aiming to have close monitoring over the implementation of pathways developed a so called Pathway Monitoring and Evaluation Tool (PAMET) to support delivery of the overall result. This was produced on voluntary basis but it proved to be a good tool and useful digital platform that includes more comprehensive and wider data of targeted unemployed categories. Public employment services have expressed a great interest in the tool and ILO is working with interested PESs to transfer this for wider use. This also one of the unexpected results.
On the output level results as per indicator are mainly expected as described below:
Number of employed youth, rural women and vulnerable categories of unemployed (longterm unemployed persons, persons with disabilities and Roma, including beneficiaries of social assistance from those categories) 625 indicator. The implementation is on track with large scale results to take place at a later stage of implementation.
Number of employed youth, rural women and vulnerable categories of unemployed (longterm unemployed persons, persons with disabilities and Roma, including beneficiaries of social assistance) which benefited from the implementation of these methods in respective local employment bureaus are 1, 250. The implementation is on track and higher number (1 673) entered pathways which was unexpected while 1 276 of them participating in programs tailored to the specific barriers they face.
Number of implemented programs indicator 5. This indicator is also well underway with 5 ongoing programs and 16 interventions within those programs.
Number of Roma included in awareness raising in labor market indicator 800. During the reporting period 507 Roma individuals are reached and it is anticipated that by the end of the contribution target will be reached. Further, in close cooperation with organizations responsible for implementation of pathways more Roma people were included even though pathway may not been targeting Roma population. Positive outcome from this approach can also be considered as unexpected positive result.
When it comes to implementation of activities related to improving the design, implementation and performance monitoring of active labor market policies, including selfemployment, startups and social enterprises relevant for above mentioned target groups were implemented and most of them exceeded indicators.
Technical Assistance provision in terms of delivery of support to labour market institutions to improve their outreach and activation services progressed during the reporting period.
Lastly, regarding the work concerning the Youth Guarantee, the Youth Guarantee Implementation plan remains not adopted by the BIH authorities. This is unexpected result and the program team is working closely with the authorities under the aim to ensure adoption.
In terms of Communication and Visibility the project during the reporting period progressed really well in line with earlier approved Communication and Visibility Strategy. Communication reach is high and there are no noted issues or problems. The outreach activities statistically measure good results.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
